name: XBridge
fix_description: Add onlyOwner or onlyAdmin modifier to listToken(). The function is external with no access control, allowing anyone to register arbitrary token pairs with _isMintable=true, enabling attackers to mint tokens through the bridge without legitimate backing.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a very short, two-step attack: call a token-listing function with attacker-controlled parameters, then immediately withdraw all of that token from the bridge. This is an obvious access-control/validation failure with minimal protocol-specific reasoning and only a couple of external calls.
